title: Terminal: a rail of running delegations under the input bar, Up/Down to select, Enter for full screen
body:
Owner, 2026-10-02: port Coder Terminal's delegation rail into OpenAgents Terminal, ASAP.

Coder Terminal (`~/work/coder`, 0.4.0 release notes `docs/releases/0.4.0.md` "A rail under the composer"; code `bins/coder-terminal/src/delegation_panel.rs`, `delegation.rs`, `delegation_steer.rs`, `panels.rs`, tests `delegation_panel_tests.rs`, `delegation_screen_tests.rs`):
- Running delegations (Coder runs / engine sessions this thread or session started) appear in a rail below the input bar: each with its number, its agent (Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build…), and a short summary of what it is doing.
- Up moves from the input bar into the rail and through it; Down returns to the input bar.
- Enter on a delegation opens it full screen (its live steps and output, scrollable while it streams; reuse the existing full-screen run view from #10150, Ctrl+R/`/run`, with its steering composer). Alt+number / `/open <n>` open one directly.

Not wanted: Coder Terminal's in-transcript presentation of each delegation's tools. The transcript stays as it is now (grok-build's presentation).

Done when several running delegations show in the rail, keyboard navigation works, and Enter opens the full-screen view, with tests (including the pty end-to-end test).
